passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster leads music in worship.
David wanted this psalm to be sung in worship.

passages.text: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.
A fool says in his heart, “There is no God.”
These people are corrupt.
Their actions are vile.
No one does good.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is in heaven.
The LORD looks down from heaven.
The LORD sees all people on earth.
The LORD looks at the sons of men.
The LORD wants to see if anyone understands.
The LORD wants to see if anyone seeks God.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־ בְּנֵי־ אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
passages.sermon:
All people have turned away from God.
All people have become corrupt together.
No one does good.
Not even one person does good.
passages.original: הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־ אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The workers of iniquity do evil.
They do not learn.
They eat my people as they eat bread.
They do not call upon the LORD.
passages.original: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל־ פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.
passages.sermon:
God is present with the righteous.
The wicked see this.
They feel great fear.
They are overwhelmed with dread.
passages.original: שָׁ֤ם׀ פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּד֣וֹר צַדִּֽיק׃

passages.text: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.
passages.sermon: Sinners oppose the plans of the oppressed.\r\nThe LORD protects the oppressed.\r\nThe LORD is a shelter for them.
passages.original: עֲצַת־ עָנִ֥י תָבִ֑ישׁוּ כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
passages.sermon:
Israel needs salvation.
Zion is the place of hope for Israel’s salvation.
The LORD is the one who restores His people from captivity.
When the LORD brings His people back, Jacob will rejoice.
Israel will be glad.
passages.original: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשׁוּעַ֪ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָֽאֵל׃
